description: Index of Industrial Production, general and manufacturing, MoSPI: 2011-12-base index divided by MoSPI's linking factors (general 1.3834, manufacturing 1.3700) to March 2023, 2022-23-base index from April 2023; monthly and quarterly-average index and y/y, calculated by Asia Decoded (calculated = y). Also MoSPI's own y/y on the 2022-23 base as published (yoy_mospi, monthly from April 2023; to March 2024 against the 2022-23 months normalised to 100, MoSPI's method). Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/iip/in_iip_linked.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly IIP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India IIP, linked (MoSPI)
